verdict.rationale: There is no formal acceptable-use/anti-abuse policy in the evidence pack; instead, after a user asked about robots.txt support, Hyperbrowser reactively added an 'ethical scraping' docs page, but the same user's hands-on test found the service still ignores robots.txt, spoofs UAs, and rotates through a huge IP range with no real rate-limiting or opt-out mechanism — directly contradicting the implied posture. missing for 10: a genuine published AUP/anti-abuse policy, evidence of enforcement (rate limits, robots.txt honoring, terms restricting misuse), and any statement clarifying permitted use-cases for stealth/captcha-bypass features.
